m.aarti.tek: Sing, friends, sing, sing the āratī of the Beloved and her Lover, Sītā and Rāma.
m.aarti.pad1: Friends all around, bringers of joy, fair-eyed, decked in new finery and ornament, sweet-voiced as the cuckoo, with vīṇā and sitār in hand, sing out a lovely rāga.
m.aarti.pad2: The couple shine in matchless beauty; their blue and yellow garments and ornaments gleam, and at their sight the beauty of countless Ratis is put to shame. Gain the fruit of your eyes.
m.aarti.pad3: In the darting glances of their lotus eyes, in the lovely, pure rosiness of their lips, in the sweet smile of their moon-like faces, let your own eyes be caught.
m.aarti.pad4: Arrange a lovely golden platter with ghee, camphor and a fair wick to give light; holding the peacock-feather fan and the whisk, Rāmeśvara, joyfully shower flowers.
